subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

Ram was __abandoned__ by his parents at a very early age.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2) i.e. "**Left**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abandoned**: (त्याग दिया गया) - Left behind; deserted.

 
 
• **Example**: The building had been abandoned years ago.
 
 
 
• **Left**: (छोड़ दिया) - To go away from.
 
 
• **Example**: She left the keys on the table.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Left**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Loved**: (प्रेम किया) - Feel deep affection or sexual love for (someone).

 
 
• **Example**: She has always loved her children unconditionally.
 
 
 
• **Hated**: (नफरत की) - Feel intense or passionate dislike for (someone).
 
 
• **Example**: He hated his job and looked for a new one.
 
 
 
• **Disgraced**: (अपमानित) - To have caused a loss of honor or respect.
 
 
• **Example**: The scandal disgraced the family.
